audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are peers penalized for sending over-cap transactions?

code_scope.notes: P2P peer management is in eth/handler.go and eth/peer.go. Transaction validation occurs in txpool.

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Peers sending transactions exceeding gas cap (16777216) should be penalized to prevent DoS flooding.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Transaction validation occurs in txpool which enforces gas limits. Peer scoring for invalid transactions is handled by the P2P layer.
potential_issues: Peer scoring mechanism for over-cap transactions not explicitly verified in this analysis

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Transaction gas limit validation exists in txpool. However, explicit peer penalization for sending over-cap transactions requires deeper analysis of the P2P scoring system.
recommendations: Review eth/protocols/eth/peer.go for peer scoring on invalid tx submission
Verify dropPeer behavior on repeated invalid transactions

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp multiplication_complexity >= 16 for all inputs?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: ModExp multiplication_complexity must be at least 16 for all inputs to prevent gas underpricing DoS.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: osakaMultComplexity() returns 16 when x <= 32, and 2 * berlinMultComplexity(x) when x > 32. For x=33, berlinMultComplexity returns ceiling(33/8)^2 = 25, so 2*25 = 50 >= 16.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The implementation correctly enforces minimum complexity of 16 for x <= 32 and scales proportionally for larger inputs. The minimum value of 16 is hardcoded and cannot be bypassed.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is complexity exactly 16 when max_length <= 32?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: When max(base_length, modulus_length) <= 32, complexity must be exactly 16.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Code explicitly returns 16 when x <= 32: `if x <= 32 { return 16 }`

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The implementation directly returns the constant 16 for all x <= 32, exactly matching the EIP-7883 specification.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is complexity formula correct for max_length > 32 with overflow protection?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: For max_length > 32, complexity = 2 * ceil(max_length/8)^2 with overflow protection.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Uses berlinMultComplexity which calculates ceil(x/8)^2 with overflow checks, then multiplies by 2 with carry check. Returns MaxUint64 on overflow.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Overflow protection is properly implemented using bits.Add64 and bits.Mul64 with carry checks. Any overflow returns MaxUint64 which prevents gas underpricing.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count exactly 1 when exponent is 0?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: When exponent is 0, iteration_count must be exactly 1 to avoid division by zero.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: The function returns max(iterationCount, 1) at line 487, ensuring minimum of 1. When exponent is 0, expHead.BitLen() returns 0, so iterationCount stays 0, and max(0, 1) = 1.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The `max(iterationCount, 1)` at line 487 guarantees iteration_count is always at least 1, including when exponent is 0.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count = bit_length(exponent) - 1 for non-zero exponent <= 32 bytes?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: For exponent_length <= 32 and non-zero exponent, iteration_count = bit_length(exponent) - 1.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: When expLen <= 32, the first if block is skipped. For non-zero expHead, bitLen > 0, so iterationCount += bitLen - 1.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: For expLen <= 32, iterationCount starts at 0, then bitLen-1 is added for non-zero exponent. This correctly implements bit_length(exponent) - 1.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is large exponent multiplier 16 (not 8 from EIP-2565)?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: EIP-7883 uses multiplier 16 for large exponents, not the EIP-2565 value of 8.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: osakaModexpGas defines `const multiplier = 16` at line 540, which is passed to modexpIterationCount.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The multiplier is correctly set to 16 in osakaModexpGas, matching EIP-7883 specification and differing from EIP-2565's multiplier of 8.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is 16*(exponent_length-32) overflow-protected?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: The calculation 16*(expLen-32) must be protected against integer overflow.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Uses bits.Mul64 with carry check: `carry, count := bits.Mul64(expLen-32, multiplier)`. If carry > 0, returns MaxUint64.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Overflow protection is correctly implemented using bits.Mul64 which returns a carry flag. On overflow, MaxUint64 is returned preventing gas underpricing.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is final gas = max(500, complexity * iterations) without /3?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: EIP-7883 removes the /3 divisor from EIP-2565, so gas = max(500, complexity * iterations).

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: osakaModexpGas calculates `carry, gas := bits.Mul64(iterationCount, multComplexity)` without any division, then returns `max(gas, minGas)` where minGas=500.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The implementation correctly omits the /3 divisor present in berlinModexpGas. The formula is exactly complexity * iterations with max(500, ...) floor.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is minimum gas floor 500 (not 200)?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: EIP-7883 raises minimum gas from 200 (EIP-2565) to 500.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: osakaModexpGas defines `const minGas = 500` and returns `max(gas, minGas)`.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: minGas is correctly set to 500 in osakaModexpGas, matching EIP-7883. Compare to berlinModexpGas which has minGas = 200.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas cost deterministic and identical across all clients?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Gas calculation must be deterministic to prevent consensus failure across clients.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Gas calculation uses only integer arithmetic with deterministic operations. No floating point, no random values, no platform-specific behavior.
potential_issues: Cross-client verification requires testing against other implementations

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Geth implementation uses deterministic integer arithmetic. Cross-client consistency requires external verification but the implementation follows spec correctly.
recommendations: Verify against Ethereum execution spec tests

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is all ModExp arithmetic overflow-protected (256-bit or arbitrary precision)?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: All arithmetic operations must be overflow-protected to prevent gas underpricing.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: All multiplications use bits.Mul64 with carry checks. All additions use bits.Add64 with carry checks. Overflow returns MaxUint64.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Comprehensive overflow protection using Go's math/bits package. All arithmetic operations check for overflow and return MaxUint64 on overflow.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is complexity * iterations product overflow-protected?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: The final multiplication of complexity * iterations must be overflow-protected.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Uses bits.Mul64 with carry check for the final multiplication.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The product multiplication explicitly checks for overflow using bits.Mul64 and returns MaxUint64 on overflow.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is memory allocation bounded before EIP-7823 limits applied?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Memory allocation for large inputs must be bounded to prevent OOM attacks.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: EIP-7823 enforces a 1024-byte cap on base/exp/mod length at line 625: `if c.eip7823 && (inputLenOverflow || max(baseLen, expLen, modLen) > 1024)` returns error.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: EIP-7823 cap is enforced before any memory allocation for operands. The check at line 625 prevents large allocations.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is max_length 32/33 branch boundary identical across clients?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: The branch at max_length=32/33 must be consistent: <= 32 returns 16, > 32 uses formula.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Branch condition is `if x <= 32` which includes 32 in the constant-16 branch. At x=33, the else branch executes.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The boundary is clearly defined with `<= 32` condition. x=32 returns 16, x=33 enters the calculation branch.
recommendations: Verify other clients use the same boundary condition

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is there NO division by 3 in the EIP-7883 formula?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: EIP-7883 removes the /3 divisor from EIP-2565.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: osakaModexpGas has no divisor constant or division operation. Compare berlinModexpGas which has `divisor = 3` and `gas /= divisor`.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Confirmed: osakaModexpGas has no division operation. The /3 divisor exists only in berlinModexpGas.

audit_items.title: Is the minimum 500 gas floor always applied when computed gas < 500?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Gas must be at least 500 for all inputs.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Final return statement is `return max(gas, minGas)` where minGas=500.
phase2_code_analysis.code_excerpt: return max(gas, minGas)

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The max() function guarantees the floor is always applied when gas < 500.

audit_items.title: Is ModExp execution time bounded and proportional to gas charged?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Execution time must be proportional to gas to prevent DoS.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: EIP-7823 caps inputs to 1024 bytes, limiting computation. EIP-7883 increases gas cost to better reflect actual computation time.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: EIP-7823's 1024-byte cap combined with EIP-7883's increased gas costs aims to ensure proportionality. Full verification requires benchmarking.
recommendations: Benchmark worst-case inputs against gas costs

audit_items.title: Is block processing time acceptable with maximum ModExp calls at minimum gas?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Block gas limit / 500 minimum gas calls must complete within attestation window.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: With block gas limit ~30M and minimum 500 gas, ~60K ModExp calls maximum. Each minimum-gas call uses small inputs bounded by gas economics.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Theoretical analysis suggests acceptable performance due to input size bounds, but empirical testing is required.
recommendations: Run performance benchmarks with maximum calls at minimum gas

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does ModExp check gas availability BEFORE executing?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Gas must be checked before computation to prevent free execution.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: RequiredGas is called by the EVM before Run. The precompile interface ensures gas is deducted before execution.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The PrecompiledContract interface ensures RequiredGas is called and gas is checked before Run is invoked.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count >= 1 for all inputs?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: iteration_count must be at least 1 to prevent zero-cost execution.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Function returns `max(iterationCount, 1)` ensuring minimum of 1.
phase2_code_analysis.code_excerpt: return max(iterationCount, 1)

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: The max(iterationCount, 1) guarantees minimum of 1 for all inputs.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does ModExp handle all edge case inputs deterministically?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Edge cases (zero lengths, boundary values) must be handled deterministically.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Special cases: baseLen=0 && modLen=0 returns empty slice (line 629-631). mod.BitLen()==0 returns zero-padded result (line 640-642).

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Edge cases are handled with deterministic behavior. Zero-length and zero-value inputs produce defined outputs.
recommendations: Verify against Ethereum execution spec tests for edge cases

audit_items.title: Is gas = max(500, 16*1) = 500 for smallest ModExp inputs?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Minimum inputs should produce gas = max(500, 16*1) = 500.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: For max_length <= 32: complexity=16. For exponent=0: iterations=1. Gas = max(500, 16*1) = max(500, 16) = 500.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: For smallest valid inputs: complexity=16, iterations=1, gas=max(500, 16)=500. Correct per specification.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are P2P messages always independently validated regardless of peer reputation?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Every message must be validated regardless of peer reputation to prevent trust bypass.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: Transaction validation occurs in txpool for all incoming transactions, regardless of source peer.
potential_issues: Detailed P2P trust model requires further analysis

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Geth validates all transactions through the same txpool validation regardless of peer. No peer-based validation bypass observed.
recommendations: Verify no fast-path exists for 'trusted' peers

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas computed before memory allocation?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: Gas check must occur before memory allocation to prevent OOM attacks.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: RequiredGas is called first by EVM. Run checks EIP-7823 bounds before getData allocations. Large allocations gated by gas cost.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: PrecompiledContract interface ensures RequiredGas is called and gas checked before Run. EIP-7823 bounds check before allocations in Run.

audit_items.title: Do specific EIP-7883 test vectors produce expected gas costs?

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7825 gas cap activated only at Fusaka fork block?

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7883 ModExp formula activated only at Fusaka fork block?

phase1_requirements_trace.requirement_summary: EIP-7883 formula must activate only at Fusaka fork.

phase2_code_analysis.implementation_summary: RequiredGas checks `c.eip7883` to select osakaModexpGas vs berlinModexpGas. PrecompiledContractsOsaka sets eip7883: true.

phase3_formal_audit.rationale: Fork-specific precompile maps control formula selection. EIP-7883 formula only used when eip7883 flag is true.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-024: Do corrupted withdrawal instructions from the consensus layer fail validation before crediting amounts?
